name: Google Vulnerability Reward Program (VRP)
description: Google's vulnerability reward program covering Chrome, Android, and critical open source. High-value findings reviewed by panel of senior security engineers. Also includes Patch Rewards for open source security improvements.

peerReview.processDescription: Internal triage by Google engineers. High-value findings reviewed by panel of senior security engineers. Bounty tiers based on severity, exploitability, and report quality. Patch Rewards for open source security improvements.

attribution.attributionNotes: CVE credits, limited public acknowledgment. Private relationship with researchers. Payment amounts serve as indirect validation of skill.

povsAlignment.description: Vendor vulnerability reward program with internal engineer triage and CVE credits.
